about: packages/nmd/src/props.json: the nmd story's part of the catalogue of 3D sets (props; docs/props.md, tools/packages/SPEC.md "Miniatures"): what the design room's card of each of its miniatures shows; code is authoritative

sets.shows: The multiplex network of rare muscle diseases: 71 layers of gene links (phenotypes, pathways, drug targets, co-essential genes, 39 co-expression layers, 27 protein-interaction layers) stacked into a tower with the same gene at the same spot in every layer. Pick a disease group to light its module, seeds, endotypes, a random walk, a squashed endotype grid, z-score bars or a pair of groups.
sets.frame: Centred on the origin, y up; layers top to bottom in data order with 0.08 gaps between categories.

data.text: The authors' analysis files (ikerdata): 1,182 genes, 125,463 layer-links, endotypes. Layer z-scores (degree-matched random sets), walk visits and endotype names (most typical GO process) are computed by the generator as stand-ins until the authors send theirs. No patient or variant data.

sets.notes: Build 70 to 235 ms; 5 to 7 draw calls; up to ~42,000 link entries in any settled state. Rich api (setState, walk, pick, links, linkStats, members, seeds, genePos, pair ...). Needs NMD_DATA pasted before it.

sets.shows: The motor unit from nerve to sarcomere, and the heart: spinal cord, motor and sensory neurons, myelinated axons, six neuromuscular junctions, a fascicle of 20 striated fibres with one opened to show myofibrils, a magnified sarcomere with myosin, actin, titin, Z-discs and M-band, and a smooth surface-net heart with great vessels. Sites can be highlighted and shown with impulses or contraction.
sets.frame: Read left to right, y up; ventral points right (+x). Heart centre (0.30, 0.29, -0.12).

data.text: Anatomy is drawn. Only the disease groups' names, colours and body site are read (for the Diseases on/off colouring).

sets.notes: The heart is a signed distance field polygonised by surface nets as a job in slices (idle(dt), finish()); it fades in once built (about 0.4 s of work). keepClear is exported so a headset never brings a close view nearer than 0.35 m. Reused unchanged by the endotype story.

sets.shows: The stress test on a supercomputer: a hall of racks with a cold aisle, blinking lights, cable trays and a glass door, and the field of tiny towers it computes, stretching to the horizon. Each tower is a stack of 20 glowing discs; far ones are single points.
sets.frame: Floor at y = -0.3; hall fits |x|, |z| < 0.85; the field extends to about 22 units.
sets.size: 1 unit ~ 4 m (racks 2 m tall); field far beyond the usual radius on purpose

params.name: hpc_a
params.meaning: the set's fade, 0 hidden to 1 shown (applied by the engine through setAlpha; a set never applies it itself)

params.name: hpc_racks
params.meaning: the racks rise out of the floor, nearest first, then their lights power on; trays, lights and glass come in last (default 1)

params.name: hpc_field
params.meaning: the field spreads from the hall to the horizon: a cyan ring runs across the floor, sparks stream out of the hall to it, towers build disc by disc as it passes (default 0)

params.name: hpc_remove
params.meaning: in a wave from the hall outwards (an amber ring on the floor), discs vanish from each tower in its own order (a brief flash, then they widen and fade)

sets.notes: 11 draw calls, 176k triangles, 25k points. Exports keepOut and still (the engine keeps the camera out of the racks and rests the explore sway), streamMat, counts.
